summary: iter129 — Verified the re-created Customer Expo 'My Bookings' page (/(customer)/orders) as a 1:1 port of Web Panel BookingsView. NO 'VirtualizedLists should never be nested' console warning on orders/wallet/refunds/custom_jobs. Backend endpoints all return 200 with expected shape.

frontend_verified.VirtualizedLists warning check: Zero occurrences on /orders, /wallet, /refunds, /custom_jobs (previously reported warning is FIXED).

critical_code_review_comments: orders.tsx and BookingCard/BookingDialogs/BookingDrawers appear well modularised. No files >700 lines noted during scan (recommend confirming BookingCard/BookingDialogs sizes remain under threshold as more per-status branches accrue).

cancel-confirm is a React Native Pressable — on RN-web the HTML disabled attribute is not set even when logically disabled. Automated 'confirm should be disabled until reason picked' checks must click and assert no state change, not rely on is_disabled().

In this dataset AZOF3C0ED has status=completed but payment_status=pending — the completed branch of the action chips still renders details+invoice+repeat which matches web panel behaviour. Consider whether 'invoice' should be hidden until payment_status is paid to avoid 'Invoice is not generated yet' toasts.

Chat/Rate/Book-Again/Reschedule flows were not exercised in this run to avoid mutating booking state; they exist as testIDs (chat-<CODE>, review-<CODE>, repeat-<CODE>) and are visible on qualifying cards but functional validation of the network mutations is deferred to a follow-up run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the tested acceptance set (page structure, KPIs, tabs+counts, search, sort, filter sheet + presets, cancel dialog with backend preview, details drawer, invoice drawer, VirtualizedLists warning fix)
